How it started

The two biggest games of 2026 are set to launch just a few weeks apart in November.

On the one side you have the behemoth that is Grand Theft Auto VI , an experience 13 years in the making, and the sequel to one of the best-selling games in history. Its predecessor, GTA V , has sold a staggering 230 million copies since it launched in 2013, and was re-released …
